1.web: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
1.asv: Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;

2.web: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
2.asv: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;

3.web: remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.
3.asv: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; [Selah

4.web: May He grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
4.asv: Grant thee thy heart’s desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.

5.web: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
5.asv: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.

6.web: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
6.asv: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.

7.web: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of Yahweh our God.
7.asv: Some trustin chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.

8.web: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
8.asv: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.

9.web: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
9.asv: Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call.
